name: AI travel itinerary and booking assistant

mentions.name: AI travel itinerary and booking assistant
mentions.description: An AI travel assistant that creates personalised itineraries for users and lets them book everything with one click, managing all bookings on a single platform. It also helps with contingencies to make travel planning and travelling stress-free.
mentions.problem: Travel planning and travelling are stressful to manage, including handling bookings and contingencies.
mentions.audience: Travellers looking to plan and book trips
mentions.source_excerpt: My co-founder and I, are building an AI travel assistant that creates personalised itineraries for users and allows them to book everything with one click, making it easy to manage all the bookings in one platform. It also helps with contingencies making travel planning and travelling, as a whole, stress-free.

evidence.value: My co-founder and I, are building an AI travel assistant that creates personalised itineraries for users and allows them to book everything with one click, making it easy to manage all the bookings in one platform. It also helps with contingencies making travel planning and travelling, as a whole, stress-free.
